observations: Stacks of wooden pallets photographed outdoors on bare dirt amid trash and debris.
Photo 1 and 2 show pallet blocks stamped with an oval 'EPAL' mark, a European pallet standard marking.
Photo 3 shows a single pallet held up by two hands, with a vertical board crudely nailed across cracked slats — a visible repair.
Pallets vary in color/wear: some look newer and lighter, others darker and weathered.
No size markers, ruler, or scale object in any photo to confirm exact dimensions.
Vehicles and a container in background give rough scale but not precise pallet dimensions.

claims.evidence: EPAL stamp visible in photo 1 and 2 suggests European origin pallets, but stamp authenticity and whether all units in the stack carry it cannot be confirmed from photos alone.

risks.risk: Structural integrity / hidden rot or termite damage in stacked pallets not visible from outside
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the underside and joints of several individual pallets from the stack, not just the top one
risks.if_unproven: priced as used/worn condition, not as structurally sound

risks.risk: Visible repair (nailed board) in photo 3 suggests at least some units are damaged/patched, not original condition
risks.proof: Seller to confirm how many units in the batch have similar repairs, with photos of each
risks.if_unproven: priced as repaired/lower-grade stock, not as intact original pallets

risks.risk: Quantity being sold is unclear from photos (stack height ambiguous, could be partial lot)
risks.proof: A count or a photo with all units laid out separately, or a video pan of the full lot
risks.if_unproven: priced per unit only, not as a bulk lot total

risks.risk: EPAL mark could be counterfeit or pallets could be non-compliant despite stamp
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the EPAL stamp quality/placement matching known authentic specs, or a certificate
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic used wooden pallet, not as certified EPAL-grade

proof_requests: Count/number of pallets included in this lot, with a full video pan
Close-up shots of undersides and corner joints of several pallets, not just one
Clear close-up of the EPAL stamp for authenticity check
Confirmation of standard size (e.g., 1200x800mm) with a tape measure in shot
response.reason: Item is clearly identifiable as used wooden pallets with partial EPAL markings; visible repair and unclear quantity/condition mean it must be priced at worst case as used/repaired stock pending further proof.
